text_block_list.text:
And with that, race preparations are
completed.
Everything has gone as
intended.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I should be able to achieve good results
at this
rate.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The only thing I did not account for is
the rate of
my pulse.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
No matter my efforts to slow it, my heart
always
starts pounding when a race
draws near... It's
enough to make me
physically shake...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Channel those nerves into your race!

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Yes, perhaps that truly is the only
way to
calm this feeling.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
